title: Explain Your Product with Short Videos
summary: Turn a written brief into a short explainer or ad video, then cut it into clips for each channel, without booking a film crew or an editor for every update.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you pay for simple product videos today; savings come from making explainers and ad drafts in house.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Fewer paid freelance edits for simple explainers and ads.
Buyers understand your product faster from a short video.
who_its_for: Small brands and founders who need product videos.
Marketers who post short clips every week.

steps: Write a one-paragraph brief: who it is for, the one message and the length.
Review the plan, then the first cut.
Check every claim and publish yourself.
guardrails: Check every claim, name and logo before you publish or run it as an ad.
Never use real people, music or brands you do not have rights to.
